description: This is the main program file for a backend API service built with ASP.NET Core. It sets up and configures HTTP endpoints for health checks, asset management, master data management, validation, and API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI). It also initializes necessary services such as database connections, CORS, forwarded headers, and environment variable loading.

classes.name: ValidityCheckRequest
classes.description: Represents the payload for the validity check API endpoint, containing the input value to validate.

classes.name: ValidityCheckResponse
classes.description: Represents the response for the validity check API endpoint, indicating whether the input is valid and providing a reason if invalid.

classes.name: HealthRootResponse
classes.description: Represents the JSON response for the root health endpoint, indicating overall service status.

classes.name: HealthzDbStatus
classes.description: Details about the database connectivity status included in the /healthz response.

classes.name: HealthzResponse
classes.description: The full health check response including overall status and database diagnostics.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Reads a .env file if present and loads environment variables into the process environment.

methods.name: BuildPublishedServerUrl
methods.description: Determines the externally visible server URL for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, considering overrides, request headers, and forwarded headers.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenApiDocument
methods.description: Sets up server URL configuration for OpenAPI/Swagger generation based on incoming requests.
